FermentationStepType.description: FermentationStepType - a per step representation of a fermentation action.

description.description: Free text description of the fermentation step.

start_temperature.description: The temperature of the beer at the start of the step.

end_temperature.description: The temperature of the beer at the end of the step.

free_rise.description: Free rise is used to indicate a fermentation step where the exothermic fermentation is allowed to raise the temperature without restriction This is either True or false.

start_gravity.description: The gravity of the beer at the start of the step.

end_gravity.description: The gravity of the beer at the end of the step.

start_ph.description: The pH of the beer at the start of the step.

end_ph.description: The pH of the beer at the end of the step.

vessel.description: Name of the vessel the step takes place in, which is how a transfer between vessels is recorded.

vessel_pressure.description: Vessel pressure indicates the pressure applied within the fermentation vessel.
